title: Settlement Amount and Settlement Installments, Charged-Off Settlement Plan
content:
**Clause.** For the Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the charged-off balance is the loan's unpaid principal plus its unpaid fees on the decision date. The settlement percentage is the program's lump-sum settlement percent for a single payment and the program's installment settlement percent for two or more monthly installments. The settlement amount is the charged-off balance multiplied by the settlement percentage, rounded to the cent once on the final figure, and the settlement installment is that amount divided by the recorded number of installments, rounded to the cent, with the last installment absorbing the difference.

Where another rule of this policy replaces the settlement percentage, the replacement is taken first; every point that applies is then subtracted from it, and the percentage so reached, never below 30 percent, is applied once to the charged-off balance. Because a settlement request is taken only on a charged-off balance of at least the program's minimum principal balance and the percentage is never below 30 percent, the settlement amount and its installments never work out to 0.00.

## Terms of the clause

- *Charged-off balance*: unpaid principal plus unpaid fees on the charged-off Personal Loans record on the decision date.
- *Recorded number of installments*: the plan months recorded on the request — 1 for a single payment, otherwise the number of monthly installments chosen.
- *Lump-sum and installment settlement percents*: the Charged-Off Settlement Plan figures in the special programs terms sheet.
- *Floor*: the percentage is never below 30 percent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical balance; hypothetical percents of 50 for a single payment and 60 for installments)

| Charged-off balance | Recorded installments | Percentage | Settlement amount | Installments |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4,000.00 USD | 1 | 50 | 2,000.00 USD | one payment of 2,000.00 |
| 4,000.00 USD | 3 | 60 | 2,400.00 USD | 800.00, 800.00, 800.00 |
| 1,000.00 USD | 3 | 60 | 600.00 USD | 200.00, 200.00, 200.00 |
| 1,000.10 USD | 3 | 60 | 600.06 USD | 200.02, 200.02, 200.02 |
| 1,000.10 USD | 5 | 60 | 600.06 USD | four of 120.01 and a last of 120.02 |
